note: Weekly class times for the current term. To update for a future term, edit the term label and the classes below. `day` must be a weekday name; `time` is the start time (e.g. "2:00 PM"); `durationMinutes` is how long the class runs; `section` is the myUNSW section code (e.g. "M14A") students see when they enrol; `location` is optional. These classes also feed the calendar subscription (/calendar/*.ics): one event per teaching week in data/syllabus.json, for every class, with one feed per Lab stream. `cancelled` lists single dates (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) with no classes, such as a public holiday, with a short `reason`; classes on those dates are left out of the calendar and a one-day note is added instead.

cancelled.reason: Labour Day public holiday. No lecture or lab, and no make-up class.
